task.task_name: Core structural output validator and contextual detectors
task.description: Implement pure validateOutputForTransport({value,format:json|text,schema?}) with ok discriminant, safe value/text and redaction state/reasons. Follow T7 proposal; core schema validation must fail closed on unsupported schema constructs instead of claiming complete JSON Schema. Keep JSON types, reject secret numeric fields as format-unsafe, preserve safe IDs/metrics, no field-name bypass for real secrets. Integrate existing redactSensitiveText into structural handling without import cycles. Improve sensitive URL query/path detection and distinguish ordinary public Markdown links from autofetch images/actual exfil operations. Keep deterministic model-independent/no-network. Add pure helper unit edge cases before implementation as needed. Root owns guard/service/MCP integration; scanner worker owns service/report/types/CLI. Do not edit these shared files.
acceptance_criteria: Safe metrics and IDs retain values and types; provider-pattern secrets always masked despite key name.
Sensitive URL query/path values masked; ordinary public markdown link creates no exfil finding, autofetch/injection defenses remain.
Pure transport validator preserves JSON shape and reports metadata; unsafe numeric/schema representations return constant format-unsafe without secret or hash.
task.module_patterns: Deterministic security boundary, preserve public compatibility except approved fixes, fail closed with typed constant errors.
